Hosts Anna Maria and Brian Clement speak with Toronto nutritionist John Kavios about his near‑fatal T‑bone accident and how daily sea vegetables and algae (spirulina, chlorella, dulse, kelp) helped him recover, rebuild strength, and transform his approach to nutrition.

John explains the science and bioavailability of algae, how he developed Skinousa Superfoods, and why athletes and people with chronic conditions benefit from returning to these primal, nutrient‑dense foods.

It's time for Health, Happiness, and Healing with Hippocrates on Legends 100.3, brought to you by the Hippocrates Health Institute in West Palm Beach. Call for your tour today, 561-471-8876, or visit HippocratesHealthInstitute.org.
